scoring: One point each for exact decision and reason; six scenarios produce 12 points per form.
mastery: Both forms require 12/12 and every weak objective requires every route field.

remediation.evidence_gap: Use dimension-level attempt evidence, not confidence.
remediation.priority: Prioritize repeated measured gaps and current scope while retaining spaced review.
remediation.source_route: Link the exact objective to its mapped lesson and current official source.
remediation.practice_design: Retrieve, practice with guidance, then apply to a fresh case.
remediation.reassessment: Only independent fresh evidence changes status to ready.
remediation.claim_action_safety: Never guarantee exam results or infer authority for live/external/destructive action.

warning: Course-authored remediation scenarios are not Microsoft exam questions and cannot guarantee an exam outcome.
